description: Return schema 1 natal D1 longevity_reference with engine revision, effective basis, the bounded BPHS-43 preliminary three-pair method and HPA-XIV strict positional checks. Normally 8 of 20 checks are evaluated; 12 are not evaluated under this source profile. Each check is matched, not_matched, not_evaluated or unavailable, with explicit coverage. Unknown states are not absence. Matches, counts, preliminary classes and separate yoga names must not be interpreted as lifespan, death, effects or a combined assessment. Counteractions are not evaluated. No age estimate or verdict is provided.

date.description: Birth date in YYYY-MM-DD format, e.g. 1985-06-15

gender.description: Optional. A few classical yogas are defined by gender -- Mahabhagya's rule is gender x day/night x odd/even signs. Supply it when known; when omitted those yogas are left out of the result rather than computed against an assumed gender.

latitude.description: Birth-place latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 13.0827

longitude.description: Birth-place longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. 80.2707

time.description: Birth time in 24h HH:MM:SS format, e.g. 10:30:00

timezone.description: Timezone offset from UTC in hours, e.g. 5.5 for IST

name: get_longevity_reference
title: Longevity source reference
